simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הֵידָד (H1959) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הֵידָד (hêydâd) means acclamation First listed occurrence: Isa 16 9.

definitions.full: H1959. hedad הֵידָד noun masculine Isa 16:9 shout, shouting, cheer (of a multitude; on formation compare Ol §181 a Sta § 218 b ); — ׳ה only absolute, 16:9 6 t. Isaiah & Jeremiah; — 1 shouting in harvest Isa 16:10 ; Jer 48:33 (3 t. in verse) where הֵידָד לֹא הֵידָד חֵידָד יִדְרֹךְ לֹא , i.e. the shouting is no vineyard-shouting, but that of foe, compare below; compare 25:30 ׳י shall utter ( עָנָה ) a shout like the (grape-) treaders (followed by הָאָרֶץ כָּליֿשְׁבֵי אֶל ). Hence also 2 shout of the foe Isa 16:9 ( עַל נָפַל ), Jer 51:14 ( הֵידָד עָלַיִךְ וְעָנוּ ); compare 25:30 ; 48:33 above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to shout );
